title: TODO-list front-matter
description: The HTML-comment front-matter block at the top of the project TODO list (context/project/TODO.md). Keys are the <!-- key: value --> lines. Shape-only, like requirements-frontmatter.schema.json: it never validates the '## <Title>' entry bodies — the routing skill, the enums, the origin reference and the context paragraph are 'mc.py check todo''s guarantee, not this document's. See STANDARD-TODO.md.

todo.description: The tier the list belongs to. Only the project tier holds a TODO list, so this is always 'project'.
